summary: Snap Inc. filed an 8-K solely to provide notice and an information statement for its upcoming 2026 annual meeting of stockholders scheduled for July 30, 2026. The filing covers routine director elections and ratification of the independent auditor. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is described. The item 8.01 disclosure is a standard meeting notice without any special situation event. No deal terms are stated.
